scope: Resolve ambiguity before any Python/EA production risk calculations or automated trades. Existing policy limits are not modified.

open_decisions.topic: Position size and symbol contract metadata
open_decisions.required_choice: Identify broker-specific units per lot, minimum volume and step, digits, tick size/tick value and account-currency versus quote-currency mapping for each allowed pair; establish validation of contract changes.
open_decisions.unsafe_guess: Assume every FX contract/lot or tick value is identical across symbols and brokers.
open_decisions.evidence_to_collect: Read-only MT4 symbol specifications for the intended account and a reproducible synthetic valuation crosscheck.
open_decisions.acceptance_condition: Each of four pairs has verified contract metadata; unavailable metadata rejects new entry.

open_decisions.topic: Stop-based expected risk formula by direction and order kind
open_decisions.required_choice: Specify BUY versus SELL planned entry, pending trigger, stop location, absolute/worst-case adverse move, current open-position handling and missing/mutable server SL; prohibit silent optimistic price assumption.
open_decisions.unsafe_guess: Use request price as guaranteed fill or treat absent stop as zero loss.
open_decisions.evidence_to_collect: Scenario matrix for BUY/SELL, limit/stop/market, changed SL, adverse gap and partial fill.
open_decisions.acceptance_condition: Transparent price and direction inputs with measurable conservative loss bound or fail-closed noncalculation.

open_decisions.topic: Cross-currency conversion to JPY at one coherent risk epoch
open_decisions.required_choice: Define quote-to-account-to-JPY conversion paths for USD/JPY, EUR/JPY, GBP/USD and AUD/USD, side-specific bid/ask, valid observation/receipt timestamps, and fallback rejection.
open_decisions.unsafe_guess: Treat 10 USD as 10 JPY, use reciprocal conversion incorrectly, or use yesterday's rate.
open_decisions.evidence_to_collect: Synthetic long/short USD-quoted trade plus independent quote converter and broker-specific tick value checks.
open_decisions.acceptance_condition: Conservative JPY risk consistent with account denomination, observable conversion side and tested time consistency.

open_decisions.topic: Fees, spread, swap and stop slippage in planned-risk estimate
open_decisions.required_choice: Determine which costs belong in per-trade and aggregate anticipated stop loss, how to prevent double counting and what to do when uncertainty or adverse fills make a finite bound impossible.
open_decisions.unsafe_guess: Exclude fees or assume stop execution at exactly the submitted SL; state estimated risk as a guaranteed maximum realized loss.
open_decisions.evidence_to_collect: Fee/swap posting examples, widening-spread stress, broker SL and negative-slippage fault injection.
open_decisions.acceptance_condition: Conservative documented estimate and explicit non-guarantee for gaps/slippage; no missing cost silently treated as zero.

open_decisions.topic: Single risk decision snapshot and concurrent new order reservations
open_decisions.required_choice: Specify broker account/position/pending/in-flight snapshot generation, durable reservation lifetime, concurrent workers and replay behavior; unknown DISPATCHING/OUTCOME_UNKNOWN effects must block entry.
open_decisions.unsafe_guess: Add independently captured state values despite an intervening fill, or double-spend the 1% budget under two AI order requests.
open_decisions.evidence_to_collect: Interleaved create/cancel/fill/manual-change histories with monotonic generation IDs, broker reconciliations, crash/restart cases.
open_decisions.acceptance_condition: One order candidate cannot pass using obsolete/noncoherent positions and pending orders; unknown outcome blocks.

open_decisions.topic: Aggregation with partial fills, opposite positions and pending-order contingencies
open_decisions.required_choice: Define conservative aggregation for partial fills, OCO conditional pending orders, opposing/hedged positions and correlation. Do not net exposures or omit simultaneous triggers without demonstrated broker guarantee.
open_decisions.unsafe_guess: Cancel one pending order in local intent but subtract its risk before broker cancellation confirmation.
open_decisions.evidence_to_collect: Multiple simultaneous order/fill scenarios, split lots, hedge orders and missing server acknowledgments.
open_decisions.acceptance_condition: All potentially executable exposures counted once without optimistic unproven offsets.

open_decisions.topic: Precision, risk boundary, lot rounding and invalid quantities
open_decisions.required_choice: Approve decimal precision, currency rounding, thresholds for equality, minimum lot and nonnegative/finite validity; above-limit risk is rejected and never rounded down to pass.
open_decisions.unsafe_guess: Binary floating-point or a nearest-yen rounding drops a 500.01 JPY estimate to the 500 JPY threshold.
open_decisions.evidence_to_collect: Boundary cases 499.99/500/500.01 and 999.99/1000/1000.01 plus volume-step tests.
open_decisions.acceptance_condition: Monotone, reproducible precise comparisons with account/broker precision validated, and no inflated volume.

open_decisions.topic: Daily net equity change, loss offset and independent PnL reconciliation
open_decisions.required_choice: Confirm profit offset policy, commissions/swap classification, correction latency, opening equity and external cashflow effective time at NY17, discrepancy tolerances and bounded age.
open_decisions.unsafe_guess: Use current equity as the fixed day denominator or treat deposits as profit and later corrections as harmless.
open_decisions.evidence_to_collect: NY17 boundary examples including DST, late deposit/withdrawal, fee posted after close, missing opening snapshot and independent ledger discrepancy.
open_decisions.acceptance_condition: Reproducible fixed 1.5% opening limit, independently reconcilable adjusted daily loss and fail-closed on indeterminate figures.

open_decisions.topic: Unitized DD issuance/redemption, high-water and restart recovery
open_decisions.required_choice: Approve starting units/unit price, issue and redeem rules, ordering for simultaneous transfers and quote updates, zero/negative equity behavior, HWM persistence, reset and human-gated DD4/5 stop.
open_decisions.unsafe_guess: Reset high-water after deposit or drop the DD4% stop once unit value recovers.
open_decisions.evidence_to_collect: Cash in/out examples, unit HWM recomputation, simultaneous timestamps, interrupted persistence and negative/zero account state.
open_decisions.acceptance_condition: External transfers do not cause false DD changes; DD4/5 stop survives recovery and restarts pending approval.

open_decisions.topic: Per-data freshness and timebase / NY17 calendar
open_decisions.required_choice: Approve separate timestamps, maximum age, causal epoch and market availability for equity/positions/pending/quotes/FX conversion/ledger, NY17 DST/holiday rules and clock discontinuity failures. Preserve Q128 <=15 seconds only for DD2/3 monitor release.
open_decisions.unsafe_guess: Apply the DD monitor 15-second window to all order, price and daily snapshot data.
open_decisions.evidence_to_collect: Stale/cross-epoch fixtures, sleep/wake clock jumps, EDT/EST and trading holidays with missing or reversed observations.
open_decisions.acceptance_condition: All critical inputs have explicit provenance and source-appropriate limits or new order is denied; no universal TTL invented.
